text:
emma (partnerships): Polaris HW asked for a short calibration + perf/W matrix Thurs 9am PT. Request: anonymized aggregates only; partner wants a short public-ready paragraph if numbers look good. Can we scope artifacts and an embargo window?

ravi (eng-performance): We can do a 3x profile sweep (stock, memcopy-tuned, quantized-int8). Keep `--agg-hotspots=7` and export metrics+power. I propose a 48h embargo for any joint writeup until both legal teams sign off.

kai (kernel-team): Patch is tiny (sched tweak + memcpy). We won't share kallsyms or raw traces. We'll output `hotspots.csv` with anonymized ids and `metrics_summary.csv` with run_id. Also include `kernel_build_id`.

thalia (bench-ops): I'll reserve rack + PDU for 8:30-10:30 PT. Bench-bot will timestamp everything and upload to s3://redwood-partner-exchange/polaris/calibration/. I'll tag artifacts with `run_id=polaris-cal-2026-06-10-1`.

polaris-hw: We can provide wall power at 125ms resolution and SoC telemetry (freq,temp). CSV headers we need: `ts_ms,power_w,soc_freq_mhz,board_temp_c,run_id`. We won't accept any artifacts that include hostnames.

ravi (eng-performance): Command we'll run (two kernels x three profiles):

```
./bench_runner --model=redwood-tiny --seq=1024 --batch=8 \
  --profiles=stock,memcpy-tuned,int8 \
  --runs=3 --agg-hotspots=7 \
  --export-power=power_<run_id>.csv --export-agg=metrics_<run_id>.csv \
  --export-hotspots=hotspots_<run_id>.csv
```

bench-bot: Prechecks OK. Will run a 5m validation then full sweep. Artifacts will be uploaded with `run_id=polaris-cal-2026-06-10-1`. Estimated wall time 50m. :robot_face:

kai (kernel-team): Telemetry contract headers I'm proposing for `metrics_summary.csv`: `run_id,timestamp_s,throughput_tok_s,avg_power_w,efficiency_tok_per_w,hotspot_count,kv_cache_hit_rate`. I'll open a tiny PR to bench-metadata repo with that schema (no symbols).

legal-bot: Reminder: do not publish partner-identifying performance numbers prior to NDA sign-off. If a joint statement is desired, file PR to coms repo and tag `legal-review` and `partner-review`. 48h embargo requested by @ravi is noted.

emma (partnerships): For the joint announcement we only want a 2-3 sentence blurb with top-line perf/W and a link to the full technical appendix (partner agreed) — but only after reviews. We'll draft a placeholder and share it in this thread after the run.

thalia (bench-ops): Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/polaris-cal. I'll be oncall 8:15-10:45 PT. Partner confirmed they'll join the call and mute logs.

polaris-hw: Confirmed. We'll join and provide power CSVs but not any host-level logs. Read-only S3 access please.

ravi (eng-performance): Pushed example CSVs + sample hotspots to the runbook. I've redacted any build host IDs.

bench-bot: Run started at 1887655400. Will post condensed summary with `throughput_tok_s`, `avg_power_w`, and `efficiency_tok_per_w` plus hotspots file when finished.
